201.name: First Steps
201.description: Turn in First Steps after defeating 5 Hens to receive your first class skill book and potions. Open your bag and double-click the book to learn.
201.objective: Turn in First Steps after defeating 5 Hens to receive your first class skill book and potions. Open your bag and double-click the book to learn.

202.name: Meet the Butcher
202.description: Speak to the Butcher in the village.
202.objective: Speak to the Butcher in the village.

203.name: Provisions for the Road
203.description: Hunt Deer for 5 pieces of Venison and bring them to the Butcher.
203.objective: Hunt Deer for 5 pieces of Venison and bring them to the Butcher.

204.name: The Blacksmith’s Test
204.description:
Put your class skill to use: defeat a total of 10 Scarecrows, Hooking Cats or Raking Cats in Bichon to earn equipment and supplies. Taoists also receive a Healing skill book, usable at level 7.
The blacksmith trial rewards your second class skill book. Use it from your bag at level 5. Heavy Strike books are quest rewards only and no longer drop.
204.objective:
Put your class skill to use: defeat a total of 10 Scarecrows, Hooking Cats or Raking Cats in Bichon to earn equipment and supplies. Taoists also receive a Healing skill book, usable at level 7.
The blacksmith trial rewards your second class skill book. Use it from your bag at level 5. Heavy Strike books are quest rewards only and no longer drop.

205.name: Planks for the Ferryman
205.description: Deliver the planks to the Ferryman by the river in Bichon.
205.objective: Deliver the planks to the Ferryman by the river in Bichon.

206.name: Find Xiaobao
206.description: Enter Oma Cave from Bichon and find Xiaobao on 2F.
206.objective: Enter Oma Cave from Bichon and find Xiaobao on 2F.

207.name: Scorpion Tail Remedy
207.description: Use the village or Bichon station to teleport near the tomb entrance, then enter Floor 1. Defeat a scorpion, pick up its tail and bring it to the Peddler. Double-click a Town Scroll in your bag to return to your home town, then visit the Peddler. More scrolls are sold at the village potion shop.
207.objective: Use the village or Bichon station to teleport near the tomb entrance, then enter Floor 1. Defeat a scorpion, pick up its tail and bring it to the Peddler.

208.name: Dragonroot
208.description: Defeat Omas and press F to pick up Longyang Grass. Turn it in to the Peddler for a Town Scroll; keep it for your return from the tomb.
208.objective: Defeat Omas and press F to pick up Longyang Grass. Turn it in to the Peddler for a Town Scroll; keep it for your return from the tomb.

209.name: Medicine for Old Wang
209.description: Deliver the Peddler’s medicine powder to Old Wang.
209.objective: Deliver the Peddler’s medicine powder to Old Wang.

210.name: Trouble in the Tomb
210.description: Defeat the Bone Elite on Oma Cave 2F.
210.objective: Defeat the Bone Elite on Oma Cave 2F.

211.name: Secrets of the Tomb
211.description: Obtain the Tomb Manuscript from Zombies in the Mine. Old Wang can send you to the mine entrance.
211.objective: Obtain the Tomb Manuscript from Zombies in the Mine. Old Wang can send you to the mine entrance.

212.name: The Temple Entrance
212.description: A Temple Scroll grants entry to Wooma Hall. One scroll is consumed each time. Defeat the Bone Elite on Oma Cave 2F to replenish your supply.
212.objective: A Temple Scroll grants entry to Wooma Hall. One scroll is consumed each time. Defeat the Bone Elite on Oma Cave 2F to replenish your supply.

213.name: The Wooma Emblem
213.description: Obtain a Mysterious Emblem from a Wooma Guardian or Wooma Taurus. Bring it to the Lord of Bichon to receive a Medal of Honour.
213.objective: Obtain a Mysterious Emblem from a Wooma Guardian or Wooma Taurus. Bring it to the Lord of Bichon to receive a Medal of Honour.

214.name: Wooma Water
214.description: Bring 10 portions of Wooma Water to the Demon Merchant to receive a Wooma weapon for your class.
214.objective: Bring 10 portions of Wooma Water to the Demon Merchant to receive a Wooma weapon for your class.

215.name: Clear the Dungeon
215.description: Travel through the Mine, Dead Mine and Connecting Passage to Dungeon 1F. Defeat any 30 monsters there.
215.objective: Travel through the Mine, Dead Mine and Connecting Passage to Dungeon 1F. Defeat any 30 monsters there.

216.name: The Zuma Letter
216.description: Cross the Death Abyss and Crossroads to reach Zuma Temple. Dark Zuma Archers carry the secret letter.
216.objective: Cross the Death Abyss and Crossroads to reach Zuma Temple. Dark Zuma Archers carry the secret letter.

217.name: The Scholar’s Translation
217.description: Find the Mysterious Scholar in the Mine and ask him to decipher the letter.
217.objective: Find the Mysterious Scholar in the Mine and ask him to decipher the letter.

218.name: Venomous Spider Silk
218.description: Enter Red Moon Valley from the Crossroads. Collect 5 bundles of Venomous Spider Silk from the three spider species there.
218.objective: Enter Red Moon Valley from the Crossroads. Collect 5 bundles of Venomous Spider Silk from the three spider species there.

219.name: Pandora’s Box
219.description: Defeat a Blood Zombie in Red Moon Valley to obtain Pandora’s Box.
219.objective: Defeat a Blood Zombie in Red Moon Valley to obtain Pandora’s Box.

220.name: The Five Fragments
220.description: Collect fragments from Zuma Taurus, White Boar, Wooma Taurus, Bone Elite and the Ghoul in the Mine. Combine them in Pandora’s Box to make an Ancient Relic, then hand it in.
220.objective: Collect fragments from Zuma Taurus, White Boar, Wooma Taurus, Bone Elite and the Ghoul in the Mine. Combine them in Pandora’s Box to make an Ancient Relic, then hand it in.

221.name: Breaking the Seal
221.description: Bring the Ancient Relic to the Lord of Bichon to receive Demon-Sealing Water.
221.objective: Bring the Ancient Relic to the Lord of Bichon to receive Demon-Sealing Water.

222.name: The Demon in the Palace
222.description: Ask the Lord of Bichon to send you to Bichon Palace. Use Demon-Sealing Water to summon the Ancient Demon and obtain a Black Feather.
222.objective: Ask the Lord of Bichon to send you to Bichon Palace. Use Demon-Sealing Water to summon the Ancient Demon and obtain a Black Feather.

223.name: Beyond the First Gate
223.description: Pass through Bichon’s south gate and find the Frontier Veteran beyond the first gate.
223.objective: Pass through Bichon’s south gate and find the Frontier Veteran beyond the first gate.

224.name: Trouble at the Frontier
224.description: Defeat a total of 25 Oma Warriors or Yobs beyond the first gate.
224.objective: Defeat a total of 25 Oma Warriors or Yobs beyond the first gate.

225.name: Foxes of Mourning Moon
225.description: Pass through the Blood Cavern to Mourning Moon Mountain and defeat 25 Foxes.
225.objective: Pass through the Blood Cavern to Mourning Moon Mountain and defeat 25 Foxes.

226.name: Heart of Lava
226.description: Travel to Lava Hell, defeat the Lava Demon and obtain the Heart of Lava.
226.objective: Travel to Lava Hell, defeat the Lava Demon and obtain the Heart of Lava.

227.name: The Frozen Hero
227.description: Speak to the Frozen Hero near the Frontier Veteran.
227.objective: Speak to the Frozen Hero near the Frontier Veteran.

228.name: The Manor Veteran
228.description: Return to Bichon. Ask the Lord of Bichon to send you to the Manor, then speak to the veteran there.
228.objective: Return to Bichon. Ask the Lord of Bichon to send you to the Manor, then speak to the veteran there.

230.name: A Token of Passage
230.description: Obtain a Hidden Realm Token from Wooma Taurus, Zuma Taurus or the Evil Ape in the Sleeping Grounds.
230.objective: Obtain a Hidden Realm Token from Wooma Taurus, Zuma Taurus or the Evil Ape in the Sleeping Grounds.

231.name: Trial of the Hidden Realm
231.description: Enter Hidden Realm 1F and defeat 25 Vengeful Zombies, then report to the Hidden Realm Keeper.
231.objective: Enter Hidden Realm 1F and defeat 25 Vengeful Zombies, then report to the Hidden Realm Keeper.

232.name: Find Mu Rushuang
232.description: Pass through Hidden Realm 2F to reach 3F and speak to Mu Rushuang.
232.objective: Pass through Hidden Realm 2F to reach 3F and speak to Mu Rushuang.

233.name: The Five Ancient Scriptures
233.description: Collect one Ancient Scripture from each of the five floors of the Hidden Realm. Mu Rushuang can send you back to 1F.
233.objective: Collect one Ancient Scripture from each of the five floors of the Hidden Realm. Mu Rushuang can send you back to 1F.

234.name: Passage to the Snowfield
234.description: With all five scriptures collected, speak to Mu Rushuang to unlock travel to the Snowfield.
234.objective: With all five scriptures collected, speak to Mu Rushuang to unlock travel to the Snowfield.

235.name: A New Chapter in the Snow
235.description: Ask Mu Rushuang to send you to the Snowfield, then find Mu Ruxue.
235.objective: Ask Mu Rushuang to send you to the Snowfield, then find Mu Ruxue.

236.name: The Illusion Minotaur King
236.description: Defeat the Illusion Minotaur King on Hidden Realm 3F to open the way to 4F.
236.objective: Defeat the Illusion Minotaur King on Hidden Realm 3F to open the way to 4F.

237.name: The Secret Ghoul
237.description: Defeat the Secret Ghoul on 4F, then report to the guide to open the way to 5F.
237.objective: Defeat the Secret Ghoul on 4F, then report to the guide to open the way to 5F.

238.name: Good News for the Blacksmith
238.description: Return to the village and tell the Blacksmith that Xiaobao is safe.
238.objective: Return to the village and tell the Blacksmith that Xiaobao is safe.

239.name: Report to the Lord
239.description: Return to Bichon and bring the scholar’s findings to the Lord of Bichon.
239.objective: Return to Bichon and bring the scholar’s findings to the Lord of Bichon.
